title: Chapter 9: Road Safety Rules for Special Situations

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Special safety precautions must be strictly observed at railway level crossings.
Driving in rain, fog, and at night requires specific visibility and speed adjustments.
Zones near schools and hospitals demand strict speed control and noise restrictions.
Emergency vehicles must always be granted clear and immediate right-of-way.
Slow down well before the crossing
At unmanned crossings: Stop, look both ways, listen for train sounds, then proceed
At manned crossings: Wait for the gate to open completely before crossing
Never race with the train or try to cross when the gate is closing
Do not stop on the railway track
If the vehicle stalls on the track: get all passengers out immediately, push vehicle off if possible, warn approaching train by waving a cloth

blocks.content: Road Safety Rules for Special Situations

items: Always use headlights after sunset and before sunrise
Dim (low beam) headlights when an oncoming vehicle approaches
Use high beam only on dark roads with no oncoming traffic
Reduce speed — your stopping distance must be within your headlight range
Watch for pedestrians, cyclists, and animals on the road
Take rest if feeling drowsy — do not drive while sleepy
Reduce speed considerably in rain and fog
Use low beam headlights in fog — high beam reflects off fog and reduces visibility
Switch on hazard lights (emergency flashers) in very low visibility
Maintain greater following distance than usual
Avoid sudden braking — brake gently to avoid skidding
Pull over safely and wait if visibility is extremely poor
Reduce speed to 25 km/h near school zones
Watch for children crossing the road
Do not sound horn unnecessarily near hospitals
Stop for school buses when they are picking up or dropping off children
Priority rules and clear-passage requirements for emergency vehicles are frequently asked in traffic rule exams.
Regulations concerning speed limits and horn usage in silent zones (schools and hospitals) are high-yield test topics.
Mandatory safety steps at unmanned railway level crossings are critical exam questions.
Always give way to ambulances, fire engines, and police vehicles with sirens on
Move to the left and stop if necessary to allow them to pass
Do not follow closely behind emergency vehicles
Penalty for not giving way: Rs.10,000
